title: Reported countrywide prison hunger strike/protest beginning 22 December
reason: The report describes detainees in prisons and pretrial detention centers declaring a hunger strike/protest; it does not describe them assembling in a public forum. A public gathering and >=50 simultaneous participants are not established.
notes: This is a preliminary scope exclusion for the institutional action only, not for the separate relatives' gathering candidate KGZ2024-12-E002. The strike's exact size, demands, and continuity remain gaps.
